name: Lemon-Garlic Tofu Skewers with Cucumber, Peach, Basil & Feta Salad
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 8-12 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lemon into a medium bowl (set lemon aside for later use).
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon zest along with mayo, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the marinade.
Cut tofu into 1-inch cubes. Add to the bowl with the marinade and stir to coat.
Thread tofu onto skewers and place on a plate. Alternatively, you can cook the tofu pieces directly on the grill pan without using skewers.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add the skewers and grill, turning occasionally, until tofu is golden, 8-10 minutes. Return to the plate.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Place in another medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the shallot. Add oil, honey, Dijon, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumber. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Medium dice the flesh and add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl along with the feta and almonds; stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and skewers between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
